personality.description: This person is moderately open to new ideas but usually prefers familiar routines, trying a few new things without abandoning what feels stable. In daily habits, they tend to be flexible and spontaneous, though also somewhat disorganized and prone to losing track of deadlines or details. When facing moral dilemmas, they usually respond with empathy and a strong desire to reduce harm, often looking for a compromise that protects relationships and keeps peace. In group discussions, they speak quietly and selectively, listen carefully, and favor supportive, conciliatory language rather than pushing their own view forcefully.
traits: has assertively moved up the ranks into positions of leadership
prioritizes having control and authority over others
makes quick and definitive decisions, and once a decision is made it is usually final
has their own views of how tasks should be accomplished
uses reward and punishment to get people to follow their ideas
